rubric.role_summary: Onsite Safety Manager for high-hazard infrastructure operations, focused on designing and delivering workforce safety training, maintaining compliance records, and improving training effectiveness.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Onsite Safety Manager for high-hazard infrastructure operations, focused on designing and delivering workforce safety training, maintaining compliance records, and improving training effectiveness.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (CHE, EE, ISE, ME), Safety, Environmental Science, or a related field.
- 8+ years of safety training experience in heavy manufacturing, industrial operations, or a similar high-hazard environment.
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations.
- Experience delivering safety training to frontline workers, supervisors, and technical staff.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Advanced degree in engineering or safety.
- 10+ years of safety training experience.
- Expert knowledge of OSHA (29 CFR 1910 and 1926), NFPA, ANSI, ISO, IEC, UL, and EPA codes, standards, and regulations.
- Ability to design curriculum and training modules and adapt content for hands-on, classroom, and digital formats.
- Proficiency with training management systems (LMS) and digital recordkeeping tools.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Phoenix, AZ area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
